slug: 2018-06-06 Equatorial Guinea and Cameroon are now more connected - AFR-IX telecom

facts.fact: AFR-IX telecom states that the Ceiba-2 submarine cable (400 km, 40 Gbps, built Oct 2015 to Mar 2017) connects Malabo, Bata and Kribi in Cameroon, and Equatorial Guinea inaugurated its link to it on 4 June 2018; as_of is the inauguration date.

note: ACE is mentioned only as a complement for Equatorial Guinea, not stated for Cameroon, so no fact.
